name: EMODnet-view collection description
abstract: Profile of the OGC API - Features collection description for collections that serve an EMODnet-compliant view of a national or regional source. Requires links to the EMODnet profile (rel=profile), the item schema (describedby), queryables, the source collection it is derived from, the corresponding EMODnet Human Activities layer and the source licence.
